opening.argument: The speakers explicitly say they are selling Bitcoin mining contracts and describe the opportunity as passive income, while presenting it as a possible retirement vehicle. Those are direct appeals to invest, not detached reporting or testing. They also claim to operate an Iceland facility mining Bitcoin and invite viewers to join weekly meetings, giving the promotion a concrete path for participation. Although one speaker says recruitment is not required, the central message remains an offer of paid mining contracts framed around income and retirement. Taken together, these statements establish a solicitation for a paid mining opportunity, without requiring any claim about actual losses or realized returns.
